limitation: Work-only Pareto points ignore lookup and backend costs. Grid aliases on the same small trajectories are not independent experiments. No selected deployable winner or generalization claim.

protocol.confidence: Each proposed prefix occurrence count divided by the original matched-suffix occurrence count; censored continuations cannot increase this joint ratio
protocol.data_scope: Existing three-prompt development-fit trajectories on archived M3 0.5B and Linux CPU 3B operating points only; no validation or reserved held-out data
protocol.purpose: Exploratory causal frequency-filtered request-local copy replay; no runtime or speed claim
protocol.search: Longest matching suffix with a nonempty confident proposal; back off to shorter suffixes only when no first token qualifies
protocol.selection: None. Report unique cycle/wasted-row Pareto points and all grid cells alongside ordinary/ngram/suffix controls
protocol.tie_break: Most recent supporting occurrence among equally frequent next tokens

scope: Three development-fit prompts per operating point,64 tokens each. Current observed request prefix only. No validation or reserved held-out data, model inference or latency estimate.
